summary: Catch Rate & Minlucks now shows attraction rates for your exact stage, cheese, and charm. Rearrange the blocks under your trap with the new Custom Trap Selector, see more in item and mouse popups, and pin more to the top menu. Happy hunting!

details.title: New
items: Catch Rate & Minlucks: Attraction rates for your stage, cheese, and charm, plus an overall catch rate
Custom Trap Selector: Rearrange and hide the blocks under your trap
Better Item Details and Better Mice: See which mice drop an item, and what a mouse drops
Spring Egg Hunt: An Egg Hunt Helper to track down every egg
Custom Menu: Pin Favorite Setups, Journal Logs, Keyboard Shortcuts, and your uncaught mice count
Better Maps: Send SUPER|brie+ to the Maptain from the map
Better Shops: See the total cost for the quantity you enter
Better Mice: A redesigned mouse view
Max Title: Custom text, a random title, or the progress bar in place of your Fabled title
Dark Mode Color Schemes: New dark and light color schemes (Experimental)

details.title: Fixed and Updated
items: Beta options are now in each module's settings
Better Maps: Completed locations are grouped, and attraction rates always show
Lots of smaller fixes and style tweaks
